| description = Mayong Mistmoore was an ancient elf who, by some unknown means, was cursed to be the first vampire. Mayong is one of the two oldest non-wurm lifeforms - the other being the last Kedge [[Phinigel Autropos]]. The vampire has grown a vast network of spies and agents throughout Norrath on almost every continent, many appearing on [[Mayong Mistmoore (Faction)|Mayong Mistmoore faction]] and [[Agents of Mistmoore | Agents of Mistmoore faction]]. His greatest foes are the [[League of Antonican Bards]], [[Venril Sathir]], the [[Ring of Scale]], and the [[Claws of Veeshan]].

Only one spawn per server on live, and a [[Server_Firsts#Mayong_Mistmoore|few versions were done on Project 1999 Blue]]. Otherwise only appears in MM due to GM events.
